title: Upgrading AcmeDB to 2.0
intro: AcmeDB 2.0 adds online snapshots and renames one config key. Most installs upgrade with one restart; drivers older than 1.8 need a bump first.

sources.quote: Snapshots are online, incremental, and restorable to any point in the last seven days.
Drivers older than 1.8 can no longer connect.
